messages:
maya: Heads-up — intake for a new model: Cerulean-7B (rotary attention variant). Want to prioritize bring-up checklist and flag runtime compatibility items. TL;DR: HF weights present, multiple RoPE scalings observed in paper, KV cache semantics look standard but need validation.

alex: Nice. Do we have the config + tokenizer?

maya: Yep. Upload link: https://s3.redwood-internal/models/cerulean-7b/weights.tar.gz
Tokenizers appear to be GPT2BPE-derived; vocab size 50256.

sam: Quick note from an initial run: generation seems to stall after ~1k tokens when using our continuous batching mode. Suspect KV cache pointer/offset bug for rotary params.

priya: Can you paste the logs?

sam: Log snippet:```2026-02-12T18:10:03Z ERROR runtime: kv_get: index out-of-range (offset=40960, length=4096) stacktrace...```

alex: Oof. That looks like our KV indexing assumes fixed head_dim shape. Cerulean's RoPE uses a different freq scaling and, more importantly, its past_key/past_value layout is [layers, heads, seq, head_dim] vs our expected [layers, seq, heads, head_dim] for some HF exports. We need to detect both layouts.

maya: Good catch. For onboarding checklist we should add explicit layout detection + automatic transpose step. Also add RoPE frequency scaling verification (sin/cos tables) vs model config.

priya: Proposed minimal reproducer for eng-runtime: run single-threaded generation with seq_len=2048, batch=1, kv_prefetch=off. If it fails, dump shapes and first 8 values of past_key for layer 0. I'll make a small script.

jonah: For quant experiments: plan is PTQ 4-bit (nf4) and a QAT-lite for attention kernels only. But first we must ensure KV cache correctness in fp32. No point quantizing buggy path.

maya: Agreed. Also add unit test for attention masking + RoPE on small prompt to compare logits vs reference HF (transformers) on CPU (float32) to detect subtle RoPE sign flips or freq misalignments.

evals-bot: benchmark snapshot uploaded — perf baseline vs gpt2-7b-compatible model: latency p50=32ms @seq=512, p95=120ms; perplexity on WikiText: 12.7 (eval config attached).

alex: Nice. Once KV shapes are validated, run our micro-bench harness to collect throughput/latency with/without prefix cache across seq lengths [128,512,1024,2048]. Keep the same random seeds for sampling.

sam: I started a quick instrument run and hit a mismatch in rotary exponent table: our default theta base 10000 vs model expects 10000^(2/d). It changes embedding frequency scaling slightly and causes small token distribution drift. Repro script attached.

priya: Action items I can take: 1) Add export-check step in onboarding that verifies config['rope_scaling'] vs computed table, 2) Implement automatic past_key layout detection + transpose, 3) Add RT unit test comparing logits to HF for a short prompt. ETA EOD tomorrow.

alex: I'll add a runtime-safe transpose utility and a one-off warning if layout mismatch is found during load. Also add a flag to force legacy layout.

jonah: I'll skip quant until we have green on all of the above. After FP32 regression-free, we'll run nf4 PTQ and run quality regressions (perplexity + eval prompts) and compare sampling outputs (nucleus p=0.9) to baseline.

maya: Prioritization: P0 = KV layout detection + transpose; P1 = RoPE scaling verification + unit tests; P2 = Quant experiments + perf matrix. Anyone disagree?

sam: fine by me. P0 is blocking.

priya: I'll also add a small integration test in CI that runs the model load + one-step generation with small cache to catch regressions in future commits.

maya: Perfect. Please add tasks to the onboarding ticket  #ML-4672 and link PRs. If someone wants to pair on the reproducer ping me. :thumbsup:

jonah: tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.

sam: I'll drop the failing run artifacts in the ticket — heap dumps + logs + minimal weights subset.

maya: Thanks all. Let's aim to have P0 PR by EOD tomorrow so we can unblock engineering quant timeline.

alex: Quick note: also verify rotary caching in multi-GPU sharded setup — past_key concatenation must respect head ordering across shards. I can own that test.

priya: Cool. I'll update the checklist doc:```
Checklist:
- verify tokenizer + vocab
- validate model config (d_model, n_heads, head_dim)
- detect/transpose past_key/past_value layouts
- compute/compare RoPE sincos table
- unit test logits vs HF ref
- run perf sweep (seq 128..2048)
- collect perf + quality baselines
- run PTQ nf4 after FP32 green
```

maya: Solid. Closing here for now. Anyone else want to add quick notes?

jonah: none. thanks.

evals-bot: Uploaded eval pack: https://s3.redwood-internal/evals/cerulean-7b/snapshot-2026-02-12.zip — includes perplexity, lm-eval harness, and 50 regen prompts for manual QA.
